sentences.text:
Advocate for the Petitioner : Alhajj I Uddin
Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam
 Before
 Honourable Mrs. Justice Susmita Phukan Khaund
 Order
Date : --16.11.2023 Page No.# 2/2 Heard Mr. A.I. Uddin, learned counsel for the petitioners.
The petitioners are the victim and the accused.
Page No.# 1/2 vs The State Of Assam on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154499961/

1 They have jointly filed this petition u/s 482 Cr.PC seeking quashing of the proceeding of Sessions Case No. 93(NL)/2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 657 of 2020 arising out of North Lakhimpur Police Station Case No. 297/2020 registered u/s 448/427/376 IPC.
Heard Mr. D.P. Goswami, learned Addl. P.P., Assam.
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that a false case was registered by the victim on being pressurised by her husband.
The victim who was terrified made false accusations against the petitioner with the offence as alleged.

Although the petitioner is detained under a serious offence,
the possibility of conviction appears to be remote and bleak as it is a false case and the victim has categorically stated in her statement u/s 164 Cr.PC marked as Annexure-6 of the petition that the petitioner did not commit any offence of sexual assault on her and the FIR was lodged as her husband exercised pressure on her to lodge the FIR.
The copies of the LCR is received.
The petitioner has made out a case for interim stay of further proceedings.
Further proceedings of the Sessions Case No. 93(NL)/2023 is stayed till the next date.
